title: SCHEDULE UPDATE — NASDARA OPENS OCTOBER 17
summary: Nasdara (Badlands DLC) opening has moved to Saturday, October 17 at 8:00 PM Eastern.
content:
SCHEDULE CHANGE — NASDARA (BADLANDS DLC)

Our Nasdara server is now scheduled to launch Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 8:00 PM Eastern Time (EDT), instead of October 16.

Please watch the updated launch countdown and our Discord for confirmed availability and connection details.

— Beyond the Outbreak Administration

title: DEER ISLE RETURNS — OCTOBER 16 AT 8 PM ET
summary: DayZ 1.30 server maintenance is scheduled to be completed and Deer Isle back online Friday, October 16 at 8:00 PM Eastern.
content:
DEER ISLE — DAYZ 1.30 UPDATE

The Deer Isle wipe and update work is underway. Our planned completion and reopening time is Friday, October 16, 2026 at 8:00 PM Eastern Time (EDT).

Please watch Discord for our confirmation when the server is online and ready to join. We appreciate your patience!

— Beyond the Outbreak Administration

title: NASDARA (BADLANDS DLC) GRAND OPENING — OCTOBER 17
summary: Updated opening date: Nasdara, the Badlands DLC map, launches Saturday, October 17 at 8:00 PM Eastern Time.
content:
UPDATED OPENING SCHEDULE

Nasdara, the map included with the Badlands DLC, is now scheduled to open on Saturday, October 17, 2026, at 8:00 PM Eastern Time (EDT).

The previous Friday, October 16 opening has been rescheduled. Follow our Discord and website for confirmed connection details and launch notices.

Survive. Adapt. Overcome.
— Beyond the Outbreak Administration

title: Deer Isle Wipe — October 15 at 4:30 PM ET
summary: DayZ 1.30 wipe and maintenance began October 15. Deer Isle is scheduled to return Friday, October 16 at 8:00 PM Eastern.
content:
DayZ 1.30 update schedule:

Deer Isle wipe and maintenance began Thursday, October 15.

The server is scheduled to be completed and back online Friday, October 16, 2026, at 8:00 PM Eastern Time (EDT).

Please watch Discord for confirmation that the server is available. Thank you for your patience.

title: News & Events Headquarters Is Live
summary: Your new HQ for Beyond the Outbreak updates, server announcements, event schedules, and patch notes.
content:
Welcome to the Beyond the Outbreak News & Events hub. This is where community announcements, scheduled events, maintenance notices, and patch notes will be published.

For discussion and player support, join our Discord community.

title: Deer Isle Field Guide Is Available
summary: Find survival advice for dangerous AI encounters, medical systems, blood types, house materials, and more.
content:
The Deer Isle Tips & Tricks resource includes Terje medicine and skills references, an AI detection radio guide, blood compatibility, House A–G and RaG Hunting Cabin build costs, and survival advice for new players.

Visit the complete field guide before your next run.

title: One Rulebook for Every Server
summary: The official Beyond the Outbreak rules are now organized in one place for Deer Isle and Badlands.
content:
Both Deer Isle and Badlands use the same community-wide rulebook. Please review the full rules before joining.

Players must also react to the final rules message in Discord to acknowledge they have read the current rules.

title: Nasdara Opening Date Updated
summary: The original October 16 date has been moved. Nasdara (Badlands DLC) is scheduled for Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 8:00 PM Eastern.
content: Updated schedule: Beyond the Outbreak's Nasdara server (Badlands DLC) opens Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 8 PM Eastern (EDT). See the updated opening event and server page for details.
